title: Kropki dot not: fog edition
author: SimonC
rules:
The same puzzle without fog of war is more difficult and can be found here.

Normal Sudoku rules apply.

Fog of war:

When you place a correct digit in a cell, it clears the fog of that cell, and potentially from some other cells. No guessing is required.

Kropki Dots:

Cells separated by a black dot have a 1:2 ratio.

Cells separated by a white dot must be consecutive.

If a row, column or 3x3 box contains at least one entire kropki dot, then all possible dots are given for that row, column, or 3x3 box.
